overall_strategy: AJ is a 6-month-old, high-energy Pug living in an apartment (but with yard access) and currently at a higher-than-expected weight (40 lb). For Journey Month 2 our priority is: 1) ensure uninterrupted daily nutrition (autoship a full-size puppy kibble bag timed to AJ's consumption), 2) supply high-value wet toppers and a steady rotation of soft training treats to support intensive training and meal palatability (especially important for a brachycephalic breed in warm weather), and 3) establish daily dental care with chewables and oral-care supplies on autoship to build healthy habits. One-time buys focus on urgent seasonal safety (cooling pad, shade, travel hydration), high-value durable gear for safety/control (harness, short leash, bowls), and enrichment/setup essentials (puzzle feeders, flirt pole, snuffle mats, grooming tools). I set autoship frequencies using conservative consumption math (bags/pouches/pack counts → estimated monthly use) so AJ won't run out during this critical training and growth period; we can re-tune quantities and cadences after the next month once actual consumption and weight trends are observed.
